story.title: Where the trade is today
paras: Morbi in Gujarat alone has about 1,200 ceramic units, which make 80 to 90 per cent of India’s ceramic exports,, according to the state government.

Asian Paints’ MyAwaaz app shows what dealers in the trade now get from a large brand: ordering, overdue amounts flagged on the first screen, prices per product and invoices to download. GoCommerce gives a mid-size maker the ordering, credit and statements on its own web address.

gapsLede: What a building materials supplier will ask about that is not there yet.

gaps.note: Tiles sold only by the box, or plywood only by the sheet, have to be listed as the box or the sheet.
A dealer cannot ask for the same shade as their last order.

faq.q: Can dealers in different states pay different freight?
faq.a: Yes. Put each region’s dealers in a group and give the group its own shipping rates. They see those instead of your public rates.

faq.q: Can a dealer ask for a project price?
faq.a: Yes. The dealer asks for a quote on quantities, your team prices each line and sets an expiry date, and when the dealer accepts, the order is placed at exactly those prices.

faq.q: Can we sell tiles only in full boxes?
faq.a: Not as a rule the software enforces. List the box as the product, with its price per box. A minimum quantity or a fixed pack size is not built yet.

faq.q: Does it track tile shades or batches?
faq.a: No. Stock is counted per product and per depot, with no shade, batch or lot.
Not the tax invoice. The invoice prints your GSTIN only, with no HSN codes or CGST, SGST and IGST lines, and there is no e-invoice or e-way bill. Keep your billing software for those.
